title: Even cycle decomposition thresholds for dense multipartite graphs
summary: Let $r\geq 2$ be an integer. An $r$-partite graph $Γ$ with vertex partition $V_1,\ldots,V_r$ is $2$-balanced if there exists a positive integer $n$ such that $n\leq |V_i|\leq 2n$ for every $i\in[r]$.
